questionText:
Arrange the following events in a chronological order:

(A) Santhals begin to come and settle in the Rajmahal hills
(B) Permanent Settlement in Bengal
(C) Cotton boom begins
(D) Santhal rebellion

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Chronology: (B) Permanent Settlement enacted in Bengal in 1793; (A) Santhals began migrating into the Rajmahal hills from around 1800, leading to the creation of Damin-i-Koh in 1832; (D) The Santhal Hul (rebellion) broke out in 1855-1856 under Sidhu and Kanhu; (C) The American Civil War began in 1861, triggering the cotton boom in Bombay. Sequence: (B), (A), (D), (C).
Hence, option (C) is correct.
